findings.claim: The assessment claims every count is command-sourced, but several reported counts have no producing command.
findings.evidence: The assessment says "PROVENANCE — every measurement below, with the command that produced it" and later marks the process goal as satisfied: "the third is honoured in this document". However it reports counts such as "7 capabilities live", "88 tests green on three OSes × Node 22 and 24", "progress.json ... 0/0", "all 10 automated checks clean; 0 symlinks", and "CI: green on the last run across six jobs" without any corresponding command or CI run identifier in the provenance list.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the exact command or CI run source for each reported count, or remove/qualify counts that were not independently measured.

findings.claim: The assessment relies on `.claude/rules/node-scripts.md` as an existing rule file even though the live file tree does not contain `.claude/`.
findings.evidence: Assessment: "The rule requiring it exists (`.claude/rules/node-scripts.md`, added after the source pack shipped a payload without its own entry file)". The live file tree includes `rules/src/project/node-scripts.md` but no `.claude/` directory or `.claude/rules/node-scripts.md`.
findings.suggested_fix: Either cite the existing source file `rules/src/project/node-scripts.md` and state generated `.claude` outputs are absent from HEAD, or add a build-status note proving generated `.claude/rules/node-scripts.md` exists outside the listed tree.

findings.claim: The assessment says Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode are configured in this repository, but the live tree does not show those configuration paths.
findings.evidence: Assessment risk 4: "Codex, Cursor and OpenCode are configured in this repo but only for skills and commands — none has a hooks directory." The file tree contains no `.cursor/`, `.opencode/`, `.agents/`, `skills/`, or command directories for those tools; only `.github/`, `lib/`, `openspec/`, `rules/`, and `scripts/` are listed.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the claim with what the live tree supports, or cite the actual paths proving those tool configurations exist.

findings.claim: The build-health section presents manual constraint results as proven despite lacking evidence in the packet.
findings.evidence: Assessment: "constraints: PASS — all 10 automated checks clean; 0 symlinks" and "constraints.md violations: NONE. Three blocking constraints remain manual (`no-symlinks`, `exactly-two-services`, `reference-repo-untouched`)". The constraints packet itself says `no-symlinks` has "No portable one-line check exists ... Manual", `exactly-two-services` is "Manual review", and `reference-repo-untouched` is "Manual review of the change's file list"; the assessment provides no manual review method or file-list evidence.
findings.suggested_fix: Separate automated checks from manual constraints and record the manual review evidence, or mark the manual constraints as unchecked/open.
